mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_purchase_intent (id, user_id, operation, deal_id, product_id, product_title, product_image, amount, currency, target_size, quote_valid_until, business_deadline, sharer_user_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, version) VALUES (#{row.id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.operation}, #{row.dealId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.productId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.productTitle}, #{row.productImage}, #{row.amount}, #{row.currency}, #{row.targetSize}, #{row.quoteValidUntil}, #{row.businessDeadline}, #{row.sharerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.version})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_purchase_intent SET fulfilled_payment_id = #{paymentId,jdbcType=OTHER}, version = version + 1, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND fulfilled_payment_id IS NULL AND expired_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: id, user_id, operation, deal_id, product_id, product_title, product_image, amount, currency, target_size, quote_valid_until, business_deadline, fulfilled_payment_id, sharer_user_id, expired_at, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, deleted, version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_purchase_intent WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false
SELECT FROM biz_purchase_intent WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM biz_purchase_intent WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT i.id FROM biz_purchase_intent i WHERE i.deleted = false AND i.fulfilled_payment_id IS NULL AND i.expired_at IS NULL AND i.quote_valid_until <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_scheduled_item_retry r WHERE r.job_key = 'purchase-intent-expiry' AND r.item_id = i.id AND r.deleted = false AND r.retry_after > #{now}) ORDER BY i.quote_valid_until, i.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_scheduled_item_retry (job_key, item_id, failure_count, retry_after) VALUES ('purchase-intent-expiry', #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, 0, 'infinity'::timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (job_key, item_id) WHERE deleted = false DO UPDATE SET retry_after = EXCLUDED.retry_after, update_time = clock_timestamp(), version = sys_scheduled_item_retry.version + 1

INSERT INTO sys_scheduled_item_retry (job_key, item_id, failure_count, retry_after) VALUES ('purchase-intent-expiry', #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, 1, clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{retryDelaySeconds})) ON CONFLICT (job_key, item_id) WHERE deleted = false DO UPDATE SET failure_count = sys_scheduled_item_retry.failure_count + 1, retry_after = EXCLUDED.retry_after, update_time = clock_timestamp(), version = sys_scheduled_item_retry.version + 1
